title: Agora's engine and the places of a market
about: The engine's C++ on the markets domain and the urban-science domain's access, compiled with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/agora/; then the City of Melbourne's Census of Land Use and Employment (its establishments by year, about 68 MB; its blocks, their floor space and their dwellings; CC BY 4.0), OpenStreetMap's ways for the city model of Melbourne's centre (ODbL), and the products made from them: the blocks' table, the city model, and the places of the market.
